name: ICON OF FAITH
text: Once per turning point you may use two different ACTS OF FAITH in one sequence.

name: SANCTIFIED ROUNDS
text: When a friendly Novitiate shoots with an autogun, autopistol, relic bolt pistol or relic boltgun and you spend a Faith point in that sequence, the weapon has Piercing Crits 1 for it. A single Faith point can be spent on its own for this.

name: AUTO-CHASTISERS
text: Once per turning point, in the attack dice step, a Novitiate may take 1 to 3 damage (never enough to incapacitate it) and use one ACT OF FAITH of that cost or less for free.

name: HOLY EMBROCATIONS
text: Friendly Novitiates ignore the Move reduction from being injured. Their Hit worsening still applies.
